title: DEX insns_size is counted in 16-bit code units
summary: The unit of insns_size in code_item is a 16-bit code unit; 10 means that the instruction array covers 20 bytes.
applies: Android DEX files and Dalvik instructions
detail: Instructions can occupy multiple code units. Units must be unified first when reading the raw instruction array and calculating the program counter.
boundary: When an exception table is present and the number of cells is odd, there is alignment padding after the instruction array; this padding does not count toward insns_size.
relevance: Avoid halving the length when restoring method body bounds from DEX records.
